name: Kunoichi Gokumonchou
source:
A female ninja is caught after sneaking into an enemy castle. Can she endure torture even after approaching her limit?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名女忍者潜入敌方城堡后被捕。已经接近极限的她还能忍受折磨吗？
